scores.label: A
scores.note: option 2 lowers the certainty ('a viable solution' for 'one of the best ways') and shifts to reducing impacts; other options weaken 'one of the best' to 'effective', 'promising' or recast it as 'crucial step'

scores.label: B
scores.note: option 2 drops the concession, adds the emissions idea and lacks an article ('Renewable energy transition is'); the others weaken 'one of the best ways' and move the concession to an awkward end position

scores.label: C
scores.note: option 4 'In light of these difficulties' reverses the concession (because of, not despite) and 'decelerating' is stiff; option 3 'potent' is slightly odd
